prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Repair the LAST reference image with minimal scene changes. The preceding canonical portraits are identity authority, followed by the room reference. Preserve the current composition, mature recognizable faces, candid expressions, body positions, complete natural arm chains, neutral wrists, crisp large readable upright wall display and its exact text, muted charcoal/sage/brass palette, warm skin and restrained rim light. Correct only the foreground paper: REMOVE ALL READABLE WORDS, NUMERALS AND SYMBOLS from the paper or open notebook, including the 90 min note. The paper may show only a few faint abstract horizontal ruling lines that follow its plane. The exact lesson evidence remains on the large wall display, which must remain readable and unchanged. Retain one perfectly straight pen with normal writing grip and tip touching paper; correct any wrist/contact needed. Do not put text on paper facing the audience. The paper is secondary and should contain no legible label. Each visible person has exactly two coherent arms and anatomically correct thumb sides. No new people. Landscape 1536x1024. cel-shaded cartoon illustration, clean bold linework, flat shading with one soft key light, slightly stylized proportions, cinematic character and environment framing, near-black space beyond the viewports, green #6BAA8A interface glow and rim light, warm brass #A89060 metal trim, cohesive series look, not photorealistic.
